name: @local/omni-memory
description: Omni Memory for any AI host: append-only transcripts, bi-temporal facts, self-verifying notes, hybrid retrieval, zero-config local semantic recall, project scoping and an interactive star map. Native DSH plugin, with MCP, HTTP, OpenAPI and CLI adapters.

scripts.check: node scripts/check-docs.mjs && node scripts/check-client-hooks.mjs && node --check index.js && node --check client.js && node scripts/check-client-load.mjs && node --check lib/embed.mjs && node --check lib/embed-provider.mjs && node --check lib/semantic-embed.mjs && node --check lib/capture-rules.mjs && node --check lib/rerank-provider.mjs && node scripts/check-semantic-assets.mjs && node -e "['package.json','locale/zh.json','locale/en.json'].forEach(f=>JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(f,'utf8')))" && node scripts/check-update-log.mjs
